content.short: Predipie is a Web3 football prediction game where fans use the Predi token to play prediction contests.
content.description: Predipie frames sports prediction as a family-friendly Web3 game rather than conventional betting. Football fans join through Telegram, make Play2Win predictions, use the Predi token, and participate in a campaign built around rewards and airdrops. AI-powered web3 sport prediction platform that lets you "Play2Win" real cash rewards using the $Predi token, offering a secure, family-friendly alternative to traditional betting.
